scope:
PROPOSED IS-2 MC CIRCUIT CANDIDATE: FPGA, autonomous local rails, conditioned dual watchdogs, permission/OPI/trip latches and 12-motor Ioff buffers.
38 motor/TX paths use actual Ioff buffers; other Ioff paths, presence filters, identity, slot-status register, flash restore and connectors remain missing.
MC_RAILS_OK uses qualified destination-rail FPGA_CRESET_N, not MC_RAILS_OK_5V. CDONE qualification uses delayed FPGA_USER_RESET_N; timing is unqualified.
Legacy progress ball is proposed as FPGA_PROGRESS_M; A2 is the independent RAW_INHIBIT_N input. Reserved enable balls now connect to EN_N buffers; vendor fit, CNC1 pulse generation and remaining GPIO allocation are open.
Bank-B qualified OE is the same physical net as OPI_BOE clear. Receiving cards must pull EN_N high from their own powered rail; those receivers remain separate unfinished circuits.
Native schematic ERC is distinct from PCB DRC, vendor FPGA fit and measurements. NOT FOR MANUFACTURE.
